title: Codex tool wrappers (ref)
desc: The codex does-nothing diagnoses and the dated fixes behind the wrapper/launcher stack.
steps: DOES-NOTHING DIAGNOSIS 2026-05-29: wkcodex appeared dead but the real cause was the skill-update LOCK file (.wkappbot/harness/code_changed_skill_not_updated...lock) which wkcodex.sh checks at startup and exits 1 ('prior work not recorded') -- the 'exit 0 but does nothing' was a measurement artifact (probe piped to tail, captured tail's exit 0 not wkcodex's 1). Lock is set on non-skill-edit work, cleared by any wkappbot skill edit/contribute. wkcodex.sh ALSO blocks on uncommitted tools/ harness files.

PROCESS.START FIX 2026-05-29: wkharness-wkcodex.ps1 launched codex via Process.Start FileName=codex; after codex.exe became codex.cmd, .NET cannot launch a .cmd -> Start throws -> caught -> silent exit 0 (the does-nothing). Fixed by resolving the real codex.exe (Find-CodexExe). Proper fix = wkwrap.exe real PE resolver.

SHADOW-WRAPPER FIX 2026-06-13: a corrupted shadow Agent.cmd earlier on PATH dropped all %* args -> every --model silently ran haiku; found via 'type -a Agent.cmd' (which-file-actually-runs), missed by code analysis. LESSON: confirm WHICH file executes before editing a dispatcher.
SANDBOX BUGS: codex exec -s workspace-write fails on Windows (sandbox disabled) -- omit -s; wkappbot cmds hang in codex subprocess (Eye IPC stall > 34s timeout).
ARGS-PATH CORRUPTION: bash -> cmd.exe %* -> powershell corrupts non-ASCII (OEM codepage) + mangles metachars + cannot carry newlines; stdin heredoc is canonical for multiline.
author: claude
